title: Schema Registry Canonical Spec
purpose: Operationalizes ADR-0166. Declares Apicurio Registry 3.x adoption, schema-kind coverage, subject naming convention, compatibility-level defaults, and backward-compat CI lane.

registry.deployment: per cell with PostgreSQL backing; sovereign-pack compatible

supported_schema_kinds: GraphQL SDL (schema and resolver contract projections generated or validated from the shared Rust-native contract source)
Avro 1.x (legacy Kafka producers; new code uses proto3)

contract_authoring_model.authoring_model: Rust-native TypeSpec-like source checked into the service contract-source tree
contract_authoring_model.drift_gate_required: future ChangeSet must add deterministic gate coverage that refuses REST/gRPC/GraphQL drift from the shared source.

BACKWARD.description: new schema can read old data

FORWARD.description: old schema can read new data

NONE.description: no compatibility check; reserved for explicit-ADR carve-out

major_version_bump_policy.rule: breaks compatibility intentionally; requires ADR + sunset window per ADR-0100

ci_lane_backward_compat.name: schema-registry-backward-compat
assertions: each schema in contracts/ compared against previously-published version
build fails if new version breaks declared compatibility level

publication_pipeline.staging_publish: step in ChangeSet promotion to staging
publication_pipeline.production_publish: step in ChangeSet promotion to production
publication_pipeline.major_version_overlap: registry maintains both side-by-side until prior major is sunset

runtime_consumer_integration.grpc: consumers fetch proto3 schema at startup
runtime_consumer_integration.asyncapi: consumers fetch event-class schema; deserialization validates
runtime_consumer_integration.rest: consumers may pin OpenAPI version in client SDK at build time

per_cell_deployment.instance: Apicurio Registry + PostgreSQL backing per cell
per_cell_deployment.read_replica_for_ci: global read-replica for fast schema lookup from CI runners

anti_patterns_forbidden: schemas committed only to filesystem without registry publication
consumer hard-coding schema versions outside the SDK
breaking change merged without major version bump + ADR + sunset window
